artifacts.summary: Measures task.md at 39,403 B and recommends whole-mode extraction (Recover/Expand/Sync/Review/Abandon into separate context/patterns files with imperative READ pointers, plus Create Task Mode's worked-examples sub-region), diverging from the sibling task's reference-region-only precedent because task.md's dispatcher shape makes mode-level extraction both legitimate and far more impactful (~66% vs ~15% reduction).

memory_candidates.content: This repo's established lazy-pointer command-slimming mechanism (task 56: todo.md/orchestrate.md) extracts a reference-appendix region within an always-executing linear flow into agent-system/extensions/core/context/patterns/{command}-{topic}.md, replacing it with an imperative 'READ <deployed-path>. <consequence>' pointer that passes a passive/imperative test (never 'see also'), registered in index-entries.json under load_when.commands. For a command that is instead a DISPATCHER over mutually exclusive modes (like task.md), the same mechanism can be applied at mode granularity -- extracting entire mode bodies, not just reference appendices -- which yields a much larger reduction (~66% vs ~15%) because every invocation loads all mode bodies but executes at most one. The risk profile differs: a skipped READ for a reference appendix degrades execution, but a skipped READ for a whole extracted mode leaves that mode entirely unspecified, so the imperative framing must be even stronger at both the pointer site and the destination file's own opening line.
